expected_closure.closure_notes: Cannot compute closure - OCR extracted 0 calls. The entire legal description is unreadable from the low-resolution scan. The parser reported 0.0000 ft misclosure with CLOSES status, which is an artifact of having zero calls (no traverse to measure). Based on later deeds in this chain, the description likely has 5 calls, possibly using the pre-survey version (S 64°22'25" W, 229.89 ft) since this predates the 2007 survey.

ocr_completely_failed.description: OCR could not extract ANY text from this scan - it is the oldest and lowest quality deed in the chain

zero_calls_expected.description: 0 calls is the correct result for this unreadable scan - parser should not fabricate calls

false_closure.description: Parser may report CLOSES with 0.0000 misclosure, but this is a false positive from having zero calls, not actual closure

common_failure_modes.cause: Zero calls means zero traverse means zero misclosure - a mathematical tautology, not actual closure
common_failure_modes.fix: Parser should flag 0-call results as 'no data' rather than reporting closure. Consider adding a minimum call count check before declaring closure.

common_failure_modes.fix: Re-scan from original deed at 300+ DPI, or obtain a certified copy from the Camden County Clerk's Office

notes: Oldest deed in the chain of title for 26 Chews Landing Rd. Grantor: Lillian A. Ragone (referenced as 'Lillian Pagone' in some later deeds - likely a misspelling). Grantee: William V. Furtkevic and Denise A. Furtkevic, husband and wife, and Dennis J. Lynch and Phyllis A. Lynch, husband and wife. Dated November 19, 1990 (per reference in Book 7797 Page 970). Recorded December 7, 1990. Block 79.01, Lot 6. This scan is completely unreadable by OCR. The legal description likely uses the pre-survey version (matching 7797/967 and 7797/972) since it predates the 2007 Humphries survey. Referenced in: Book 7797/967, Book 7797/970, Book 8566/200.
